fails_if: variable formation skips an occurrence whose variant has no resolved mapping instead of refusing it, so a thin register whose `_default` variant has no tracked slug builds without stopping
note: FK's remote delivers AMOUNT with no named variant, so the register binds the not-applicable `_default` variant; remote.toml names the register and the variable but declares no `[[variant]]`. The replaced test asserted the compile-level stale_curation_entry ("has no tracked default slug entry"). In a build, formation then meets the withheld variant and stops with a bare ValueError, so that diagnostic never reaches the ledger: the build fails as `pipeline_build_failed`. The message is pinned because the code alone does not identify the refusal. Allowed twin: scope-reference-into-an-unselected-thin-provider-is-deferred, which builds the same source with a tracked [[variant]] `_default` entry in remote.toml.
